svg.text: Held-out H100 CAD edits: partial / failed edits
propeller bore widen compute | T4 | IoU 0.63155
Remove one of the two propeller blades; keep the hub, spinner, and the remaining blade.
t5hard pan head screw U a | T5 | IoU 0.58449
Replace the round pan head of the screw with a square head of the same across-flats width and the same
thickness, keeping the threaded shaft, the screwdriver slot, and the rounded top edge unchanged.
t5hard round flange V a | T5 | IoU 0.92018
Change the ring of 4 polar mounting through-passages on the flange face to a ring of 6 mounting through-passages
of the same diameter, evenly spaced around the central axis at the same radius.
Views fit independently; use measured IoU, not apparent drawing size. BenchCAD CC-BY-4.0. FEM audit reported separately.
